archetypes.name: state-handoff
archetypes.rationale: The plan depends on precise sentinel and result-env lifecycle preservation across merged and retained paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the proposed sentinel writes, pause/resume behavior, and result-env handoffs match the current repository contracts for Step 2b, Step 2b.5, Gate B, discussion re-entry, and Split Refine returns. Look for missing completion markers, unsafe result-env reads, legacy stdout-KV assumptions, or paths where rc10/11/12/13 would bypass required state updates. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: caller-synchrony
archetypes.rationale: The change spans multiple caller sites and docs where contract drift is likely.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the plan’s proposed merged `--with-plan-size` contract against every listed caller and reference document to find inconsistent argv, rc handling, retained standalone Step 2b.5 usage, or site-specific prompt drift. Pay special attention to Gate B, discussion-round2, Step 1e after-discussion re-entry, plan-review-loop retained calls, and check-plan-size documentation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-pins
archetypes.rationale: The plan relies heavily on structural and shell harness updates that could overfit or miss regression paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the proposed test and structure-harness changes actually pin the new contracts without preserving obsolete fat-fence assumptions. Look for missing coverage around rc precedence, jq-absent boolean parsing, stderr/log preservation, helper-output suppression, site-aware prompts, and standalone compatibility. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
